title: Diastolic blood pressure
text: Measure together with systolic as one pair, at rest with the arm supported at heart level.
90 mmHg or above scores watch and 120 or above scores critical (ACC/AHA 2017). Tell the crew medical officer about any amber or red result.

citations.source: ACC/AHA 2017 Guideline for High Blood Pressure in Adults: stage 2 and hypertensive crisis diastolic thresholds.
